protocol.common_randomness: Layouts keyed by base slot and episode/draw; motor/image noise and action uniforms repeated across variants.
protocol.rnn_protocol: Intact PGC policy trajectories; same sensory input, previous action/reward, and goal-hit history. Immediate forks share exact preceding h/c; sustained forks retain their altered recurrent states; pulse forks receive one altered step then intact inputs. Sustained and pulse effects are compared against same-batch-size no-op forks; their tiny numerical differences from the original rollout are also reported.
protocol.rnn_sampling: Every 20 steps after step 40, after first goal. Pulses every 100 steps; horizons 0,1,5,15,30,60.
caveats: Evaluation-only substitutions; input distribution changes relative to training.
RNN effects compare variants of the same model, not unaligned neurons across separately trained models.
Gate restorations are local causal interventions; their contributions need not sum because gates interact.
Off-policy shadow and pulse paths force intact experience; they isolate recurrence rather than predict independent behavior.

statistics: Each training seed is one replicate. Paired t, t interval, exact two-sided sign flips. Holm correction within each eight-comparison behavioral metric family. RNN effects summarize per-seed means; samples are not treated as independent replicates.
